Specification: This module models token-finding logic for a TLA+ editor feature that identifies an operator or identifier near the cursor in a line of module text. It defines helper operators for treating TLA+ sequences as Java-style zero-based arrays, and includes a PlusCal algorithm translated to TLA+ that scans left and right, recognizes operators, identifiers, TeX symbols, step names like <n>m, and selector chains involving ! and parenthesized expressions. The translated spec contains an initial predicate, a next-state relation, and a liveness property asserting termination at pc = "Done".

CHANGE LOG
Field: OperatorDefNames | Change: verified count matches top-level definitions; file count = 113, JSON count = 113 | Reason: Phase 2 completeness check required exact match
Field: LocalOperatorNames | Change: added `Found(i)` | Reason: parametric LET-bound operator inside `JavaIndex` belongs in LocalOperatorNames
Field: LetInNames | Change: renamed from `NamesInLet` and removed `Found` | Reason: canonical field name is LetInNames; parametric LET-bound names do not belong there
Field: IfThenElse | Change: removed all action-summary/non-verbatim placeholders, kept only actual top-level IF expressions | Reason: field values must appear in the TLA+ file verbatim
Field: StringLiterals | Change: added missing literals from header comments: `Bar   (x)  !  y`, `>`, `<`, ` <3> ` | Reason: Phase 2 requires every double-quoted string literal in the file
Field: ProofCommands | Change: removed `ASSUME` | Reason: no ASSUME/ASSUMPTION/AXIOM block exists in the file; comment text does not count
Field: Specification | Change: shortened/normalized prose | Reason: avoid asserting unverifiable details not literally supported by the module content
Field: FunctionOverride | Change: reordered entries only; verified exactly 3 distinct EXCEPT forms | Reason: Phase 2 required every `[f EXCEPT ...]` form and no extras
Field: PlusCalProcesses | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: no PlusCal process declarations exist
Field: AssumptionNames | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: file contains no ASSUME, ASSUMPTION, or AXIOM blocks
Field: EnabledExprs | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: no ENABLED expressions appear in the file
Field: FairnessConditions | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: no WF_/SF_ conditions in `Spec` or `Spec0`
Field: ActionComposition | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: no `A \\cdot B` action composition occurs
Field: PrimedVariables | Change: verified no additions needed | Reason: all variables appearing primed in the file are already present
Field: AlwaysOp | Change: verified `[][Next]_vars` is complete and correctly subscripted | Reason: Phase 1 requires full temporal subscript
Field: TemporalSubscript | Change: verified `[][Next]_vars` | Reason: correct full temporal subscript present
Field: BooleanConstants | Change: verified only `TRUE`, `FALSE` present | Reason: Phase 1 forbids `BOOLEAN`
Field: MembershipOps | Change: verified `\\notin` is correctly placed here | Reason: Phase 1 forbids `\\notin` in SetOperators
Field: SetOperators | Change: verified only `DOMAIN` present | Reason: no misplaced `SUBSET` or `\\notin`
Field: Implication | Change: verified empty array remains `[]` | Reason: file contains neither `=>` nor `<=>` as operators outside string literals/formula extraction contexts
Field: RecordAccess | Change: verified entries are literal occurrences only | Reason: Phase 3 high-risk field check
Field: UnchangedExprs | Change: verified entries use `UNCHANGED <<...>>` with required space | Reason: Phase 1 encoding/format rule
